GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Reared in barrier prior to start. Jumped only fairly & not buistled early, Settled Down 4 Lengths Two Wide , improved marginally to Turn then Hooked Out to 3.5 Lengths 3 Wide , picked up a length in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # never a real threat

Jumped ok Wide out looking for a spot Caught 3 Wide no cover 2 Lengths (1400m), Outside Leader now Two Wide 1000, paired out Turn went early, lone leader Straight , headed 100, rallied just missing out # very tough effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Fractious in the barriers. Began awkwardly and bumped heavily. Raced wide early. Rdr reported after racing three wide without cover early, allowed gelding to stride and sit outside the lead.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok wider out pushing forward Soon After settled down fifth off fence 4 Lengths (1400m), margin almost 6 Lengths 700 trying to make Ground Wide out Soon After , Straightened Up all out Under Whip closer, chased home well Without threat # sound/kept coming

Jumped Ok Restrained thus Off Mid-Field 10 Lengths over-racing hence out 3 Wide x 800m sat back/wide to Turn Outside winner Straightening Up , Kept Finding Closest on line Sound Effort - # overraced, gave all
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced for the majority. Approaching the 900m, whilst over-racing, steadied from heels. Leaving the 300m, was bumped and put in an awkward stride.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Wide out didn't push on Caught 3 Wide had cover 5 Lengths (1200m), improving 600, wider again before Turn cornered 4 deep running on well, hit lead 100 & held rivals, good win # Wide all/tough win

Slow Out 1 Lengths Restrained and Settled Down 2nd last Inside 10 Lengths only 2 Lengths off winner, held-up and eased off heels x 600m, clear run home kept trying without threatening - # kept on behind
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Leaving the 600m, steadied after improving onto heels. Unable to be fully tested over the concluding stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down just off Mid Field trailing 7 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then Made Some Ground along fence in Straight # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Obliged to race in restricted room near the 200m.
Rdr reported mount was inclined to lay in over the final 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, made no middle stages, last and held up approaching turn, 6 Lengths rail turning, railed up rounding turn, Held Up again on straightening, got a split and shifted 3 Wide around heels nat 200m, got wider and then descended upon them late. [Stewards: Raced keenly middle stages.] # ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the middle stages. Near the 300m, eased from heels and then was held up for clear running for a short distance afterwards.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 8 Lengths 8th turning, improved to 5th in straight. (Brow Band FIRST TIME) # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 200m shifted out and brushed TRUCK STOP HONEY.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down on fence trailing a head, Drifted Back to 2.5 Lengths rail turning, hit Lead 200m, Headed 100m having had Every Chance # battled on ok
